title: SSC Delhi Police HC (Ministerial) PE & MT Date 2026
postName: Head Constable (Ministerial) in Delhi Police Examination 2025 – PE&MT / DV
vacancyDetails: 456 revised vacancies for Head Constable (Ministerial) in Delhi Police Examination 2025.
qualification: 10+2 (Senior Secondary) from a recognized board or equivalent, along with the required computer proficiency as prescribed in the official notification.
ageLimit: 18 to 25 years as on 01 July 2025, with applicable category-wise relaxations.
applicationFee: ₹100; women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST and eligible Ex-Servicemen categories are exempted as per SSC rules.
selectionProcess: Computer Based Examination → PE&MT / Document Verification / Trade Test (Skill Test) → Final Selection
documentsRequired: PE&MT/DV admission certificate, valid original photo ID and all applicable original certificates required for Document Verification.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://delhipolice.gov.in/recruitments
2. Open the latest PE&MT/DV notice for Head Constable (Ministerial) in Delhi Police Examination 2025
3. Download the e-Admit Card / Admission Certificate when available
4. Check the allotted date, venue and reporting time
5. Carry the admit card and required original documents to the venue
shortDescription: SSC Delhi Police Head Constable (Ministerial) PE&MT/DV revised schedule 2026 has been issued. The revised PE&MT/DV schedule for HC Ministerial was 02 September to 03 September 2026.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) conducted the Computer Based Examination for Head Constable (Ministerial) in Delhi Police Examination 2025 from 07 January 2026 to 12 January 2026. SSC declared the CBE result on 05 June 2026 and shortlisted candidates for PE&MT, Document Verification and Trade Test/Skill Test.

Delhi Police subsequently revised the PE&MT and Document Verification schedule. As per the revised schedule, Head Constable (Ministerial) PE&MT/DV was scheduled from 02 September 2026 to 03 September 2026.

The e-Admit Card was to be made available through the official Delhi Police website. Candidates should follow the individual admission certificate for their exact reporting time and venue.

importantDates.admitCardDate: Before PE&MT/DV as per Delhi Police schedule
